title: Open Machine CEO on Anthropic, OpenAI IPO Potential
description: Allie Miller, CEO of Open Machine, shared insights on how top technology companies are managing their AI investments to balance cost and return. She explained that frontier companies typically divide their AI efforts into two groups: one focused on raising the baseline capabilities across departments like finance, legal, marketing, and sales with modest subscription-level spending, and a second, smaller 'frontier' team that operates with significantly higher budgets and greater experimentation freedom. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bonds Fall on Doubts Over Treasury's Plan | Real Yield 8/20/2026
description: "Bloomberg Real Yield" highlights the market-moving news you need to know. Today's guests: Ian Lyngen, Head of US Rates Strategy at BMO Capital Markets, Stephanie Roth, Chief Economist at Wolfe Research, Meghan Robson, Head of US Credit Strategy at BNP Paribas, and Milwood Hobbs, Deputy CIO of Oaktree's Strategic Credit Platform. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Agility Robotics CEO on Plans To Go Public, China Rivals
description: Peggy Johnson, CEO of Agility Robotics, discussed the company's upcoming public debut, positioning it as the only pure-play US public company focused on humanoid robots with proven commercial applications. Agility Robotics is valued at a $2.5 billion pre-money valuation and expects to go public in the fall. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
